scope: Corollary 4.3 (Natural invariant nonvanishing) of the manuscript “Cohomological transfer and equivariant anticanonical sections” (preprints/Cohomological-transfer-and-equivariant-anticanonical-sections-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6e231fa726d0f6b6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be smooth connected projective over C, with smoothly semipositive L = −KX. If an algebraic torus T acts on X and χ(X, OX) ̸= 0, then H0(X, mL)T ̸= 0 for some integer m > 0, with the natural linearization. The torus may be trivial.
